## Activity

East City Eye Clinic completed 150 captures during November 2021. This represents the activity recorded for the month at the site. The service continued to undertake routine photographic work, with the available capture activity submitted for image assessment and subsequent grading.

## Image quality

Of the 150 captures, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.7 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and the result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for November 2021. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

There were 35 referable results from the grading activity. The median lag from capture to grading was 9 days. This provides the central measure of the time taken for results to progress through grading during November 2021. The site should continue to monitor image quality and grading turnaround as part of routine operational review.
